clinical_events_status_ck.name: clinical_events_status_ck
clinical_events_status_ck.value:
("clinical_events"."status" = 'draft' and "clinical_events"."published_at" is null and "clinical_events"."voided_at" is null)
        or ("clinical_events"."status" = 'published' and "clinical_events"."published_at" is not null and "clinical_events"."voided_at" is null)
        or ("clinical_events"."status" = 'voided' and "clinical_events"."published_at" is not null and "clinical_events"."voided_at" is not null
            and "clinical_events"."void_reason" is not null)

clinical_vitals_ranges_ck.name: clinical_vitals_ranges_ck
clinical_vitals_ranges_ck.value:
("clinical_vitals"."heart_rate" is null or "clinical_vitals"."heart_rate" between 10 and 400)
        and ("clinical_vitals"."respiratory_rate" is null or "clinical_vitals"."respiratory_rate" between 4 and 200)
        and ("clinical_vitals"."temperature" is null or "clinical_vitals"."temperature" between 30 and 45)
        and ("clinical_vitals"."capillary_refill" is null or "clinical_vitals"."capillary_refill" between 0 and 10)
        and ("clinical_vitals"."weight_kg" is null or "clinical_vitals"."weight_kg" between 0.001 and 2000)
        and ("clinical_vitals"."body_score" is null or "clinical_vitals"."body_score" between 1 and 9)

products_kind_ck.name: products_kind_ck
products_kind_ck.value:
("products"."kind" = 'product' and "products"."service_kind" is null and "products"."municipal_service_code" is null)
        or ("products"."kind" = 'service' and "products"."service_kind" is not null and "products"."ncm" is null
          and "products"."barcode" is null and not "products"."tracks_stock")

products_values_ck.name: products_values_ck
products_values_ck.value:
"products"."sale_price" >= 0 and ("products"."cost" is null or "products"."cost" >= 0)
        and ("products"."desired_markup" is null or "products"."desired_markup" >= 0)
        and ("products"."discount_limit_percent" is null or "products"."discount_limit_percent" between 0 and 100)
        and "products"."default_commission_percent" between 0 and 100
        and ("products"."min_stock" is null or "products"."min_stock" >= 0)
        and ("products"."ideal_stock" is null or "products"."ideal_stock" >= 0)
